profile.headline: Software Engineer | MS in Computer Science
profile.summary:
Full stack developer skilled at creating high quality solutions using React.js, ES7, Leaflet, Javascript, Node, HTML, CSS & Jest. Always pushing to learn and apply best practices, I have experience developing both full-stack and front-end web applications using the following technologies:

- React.js, ES7, Material UI, Leaflet.js, Jest
- TypeScript, Javascript, jQuery
- HTML5, CSS3, SASS, BootStrap
- Node.js,  Express, Postgres, MongoDB
- Certified Scrum Master, Agile software development
- Test Driven Development (TDD & BDD) with Karma, Mocha, Chai, Cucumber, Jest
- Cypress end-to-end testing
- Jira, Git, GitHub
- Single Page Applications

- Passionate developer of quality software on schedule and within budget
- Goal-oriented, dedicated, highly motivated web developer with great people and communication skills
